notes.en: [[character:alyosha]] is a [[element:stellar-conduct]] support who can heal the active character with Tugarin, who is summoned by his [[ability:burst]]. His [[ability:skill]] or the end of his [[ability:na]] string applies the Hunter's Mark. Consuming the mark with these abilities (or having Tugarin hit a marked target) grants the team Hunter's Precision, boosting the ATK of on-field characters. While in a [[ability:polestar-field]], [[character:alyosha]] also grants 20% [[element:stellar-conduct]] DMG. His [[ability:burst]] can additionally taunt enemies.

[[character:alyosha]]'s **[C1]** gives him 15 Energy when a teammate triggers an [[element:electro]]-related reaction, effectively changing his [[ability:burst]] cost from 70 to 55. This has a cooldown of 18 seconds.
